description: This file defines a Gradle plugin for configuring Android feature modules with specific dependencies, plugins, and test options. It implements the Plugin interface and applies configurations to a given Project.

classes.name: AndroidFeatureImplConventionPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that applies standard configurations to Android feature modules, such as applying other plugins, configuring extensions, and adding dependencies.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by applying other plugins, configuring the library extension, and adding necessary dependencies to the project.
